Health care is one of the largest 11 Global Industry Classification Standard (GICS) sectors in the stock market. Its market cap stood at about $6.76 trillion as of mid-2024. In 2022, U.S. health care spending reached $4.5 trillion—about $13,500 per person, equal to 17% of the nation’s gross domestic product (GDP).

## Industries that make up the health care sector

According to financial information provider S&P Global, the health care sector comprises six industries (and 10 subindustries).
